name: litellm-gateway
description: LiteLLM proxy as a unified gateway for multiple AI model providers (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, MiniMax, Zhipu, DashScope, etc.).

scripts.reload: curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $(grep ^LITELLM_MASTER_KEY .env | cut -d= -f2)" http://localhost:${LITELLM_PORT:-4000}/config/reload && echo OK
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U litellm -d litellm
scripts.env:check: test -f .env && echo '.env exists' || (echo '.env missing, run: npm run env:init' && exit 1)
